summary: Iteration 5 tested 3 new bug fixes from main agent on the AI Interview Engine. RESULT: 2 of the 3 user-facing scenarios PASS (recorded videos render on /results, video upload race fix in code, webcam audio=true). 1 CRITICAL regression FAILED: Dashboard Interview History section is NOT filtered by localStorage 'interviewSessionIds' — fresh-browser still sees other users' sessions instead of empty-state CTA. Backend 10/10 pytest still passing.

ui_bugs.issue: History list is not filtered by mySessionIds. On a FRESH browser (localStorage empty) the dashboard correctly shows 0% Avg Score / 0 Interviews / hidden Strong-Weak / hidden Focus, BUT the 'Interview History' Card still lists 7 unrelated global sessions (Software Engineer 63%, TEST_Backend_Engineer 70%, Senior Backend Engineer 5%, Frontend developer 1%, ...). The empty-state CTA 'Start Your First Interview' (data-testid='start-first-interview-btn') NEVER becomes visible.

Card components on /results use light-mode defaults (text-slate-800 / default white bg) but the page background is a dark purple gradient. As a result 'Overall Performance' label, 'Based on N questions answered', and 'Recorded Clips (1)' headings render in near-black on dark purple — barely readable (see screenshot). Pre-existing; not introduced by this iteration but visible in the new Recorded Clips section.

issues: Card titles use dark text on dark gradient — low contrast for 'Recorded Clips', 'Overall Performance', and per-question cards

BUT Interview History still rendered 7 global rows and the 'Start Your First Interview' empty-state CTA was NOT visible. See ui_bugs[0]. Root cause: Dashboard.jsx history IIFE (lines 306-309) does not filter by mySessionIds; it only filters by answers.length>0 && evaluated_at.

verified_fixes.result: PASS (code-level) — InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx: pendingUploadsRef tracks each video upload promise; submitInterview stops active recorder, waits 200ms, then Promise.allSettled(pendingUploadsRef.current) BEFORE batch eval. New stage label 'Uploading your last video clip...' present in stages array on line 415. Could not full-real-recording-e2e in Playwright in available time, but the logical flow is correct and webcam path verified.

Direct GET on that url returned HTTP 200 video/webm 516 bytes.
PASS — InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx line 622 <Webcam ref={webcamRef} audio={true} mirrored .../>. MediaRecorder uses webcamRef.current.stream which now carries the audio track too.
PASS — 10/10 pytest cases passing in 62.51s (TestHealth, TestLegacyEvaluateDeprecated, TestBatchEvaluation x3, TestVideoUpload x3, TestDeepCheating x3).

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx defines TWO different filtered lists from the same `history`: `completedHistory` (used by the stat card + gating Strong/Weak/Focus, correctly filtered by mySessionIds), and an inline IIFE-scoped `completed` inside the Interview History Card (lines 306-309) that is filtered ONLY by answers.length>0 && evaluated_at. That second list breaks the per-user-history spec. Fix: reuse completedHistory directly inside the IIFE (drop the duplicate filter, drop the IIFE). Also matches the DRY comment from iteration 4.
Dashboard avgScore IIFE silently swallows errors (`catch (e) {}`). At least console.warn so future debugging is possible.

InterviewRoomWithVideo.submitInterview uses `await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200))` to let MediaRecorder.onstop fire. This is timing-dependent — onstop firing within 200ms is not guaranteed on slow CPUs/large blobs. Safer: convert recorder.stop() into a Promise that resolves inside an onstop wrapper, then await that promise before reading pendingUploadsRef.

localStorage 'interviewSessionIds' is a per-browser concept — clearing cache, switching browsers, or using incognito loses ALL history. Acceptable as MVP but should be flagged to product (consider a proper user/session model later).

Pre-existing: /results page Cards inherit default shadcn light-mode styling on a dark gradient background → text-slate-800 'Overall Performance' & 'Recorded Clips (1)' are nearly invisible. Add dark variants or wrap in a lighter Card surface.
Pre-existing: server.py is now ~896 lines, /api/videos still lacks auth and path-traversal guard, batch-eval idempotency cache still keyed only on len(answers).

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes Dashboard.jsx (apply mySessionIds filter to the history IIFE or simply reuse completedHistory), retest by clearing localStorage on /dashboard and confirming: (1) avg-score-card shows 0%, (2) Interviews stat shows 0, (3) zero history-row-* elements, (4) data-testid='start-first-interview-btn' visible, (5) Strong/Weak/Focus sections hidden. Then add an id to localStorage.interviewSessionIds (JSON array) and confirm only THAT session appears.
rca of the issue: Dashboard.jsx computes a top-level `completedHistory` (filtered by mySessionIds) which correctly drives the Interviews stat, avgScore, and Strong/Weak/Focus gating. However the Interview History Card body is rendered via an inline IIFE that re-computes `completed` from `(history || []).filter(s => (s.answers||[]).length > 0 && s.evaluated_at)` — WITHOUT the mySessionIds filter — and uses THAT list for both the empty-state check and the row map. So the empty-state CTA only shows when GLOBAL completed sessions are zero, not when the current user's are zero. Fix: replace the IIFE's `completed` with the outer `completedHistory` constant, or add `&& mySessionIds.includes(s.id)` to the inner filter.
